snippets.text: Hey gamers, are you trying to jump into
Aion 2 early access but getting stuck
with server timeout or under maintenance
errors? Don't worry, you're not the only
one facing this issue. As soon as the
advanced access went live, over 100,000
to 150,000 players tried to log in at
the same time. This massive surge in
traffic overloaded the servers causing
timeouts and launcher button refresh
delays. Right now, NCSoft has put the
servers under official maintenance to
increase server capacity and fix
back-end issues. So, if you can't log
in, it's not a problem with your
internet. The game servers are currently
down for updates. Hang tight. As soon as
the servers are fully back online, I'll
update you right here. If this quick
update helped you out, hit that like
button and subscribe to my channel for
more gaming fixes and updates. See you
in the next one.
